name: Renlei Zhongjie Zhi Ri——2074
source: "Human Beings' Extinction Day: 2074" is a text-based visual novel game with a sci-fi and suspense theme. After an unprecedented disaster caused by an accident, the future of humanity seems bleak. Until April 9, 2074, a pivotal event that would shape humanity's fate occurred……
